issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers defines a method named appendElement(T[] array, T element) but Stock.java in the template calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This name/signature mismatch will cause a compile-time error and prevents students from building or running the provided template. The solution repository uses addElementToArray, so the template is inconsistent with the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers API consistent with Stock.java and the solution. Either rename the method appendElement(...) in the template ArrayHelpers to addElementToArray(...) (matching the solution) or change Stock.java to call appendElement(...). Preferably rename the template ArrayHelpers method to addElementToArray with the same signature and update its Javadoc so students and other template classes compile and match the solution.

issues.description: The ArrayHelpers method used by Stock is named addElementToArray in the solution and in Stock.java, but the template's ArrayHelpers defines appendElement(...) instead. This naming mismatch makes the template code inconsistent and will cause compilation errors and confusion for students trying to follow the guidance in the problem statement to use ArrayHelpers.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) method to addElementToArray(...) (matching the solution and Stock.java), or update Stock.java to call appendElement(...). Prefer making ArrayHelpers.define addElementToArray to keep consistency with the solution and existing Stock.java references.
